visual_inspection.method: Opened the original Wikimedia upload URL directly in Arc and visually inspected the displayed 3568x2635 image. The remote image was viewed in-browser; it was not downloaded or copied.
observations: The photograph shows a seated diner with plated chicken rice and a large red Hawker Chan promotional sign in the background.

The sign contains the Hawker Chan branding and text about the Michelin-awarded stall; the lower line visibly identifies the award as being at 335 Smith Street #02-126. The unit digits are slightly soft in the photo, so the official current listing below is used as the corroborating exact-address source.
This is a dish/brand-context photograph taken inside or at the named location, not a storefront-fascia or stall-front photograph.
No current exterior appearance, current menu presentation, or current premises operation can be inferred from this 2023 photo.
visual_inspection.visual_match_assessment: Exact named outlet and exact unit are supported by the combination of Hawker Chan/Smith Street photo signage and the current first-party location listing. The visible unit text alone is not perfectly sharp.

observed_source_facts: Current official Singapore Locations page lists Chinatown at 335 Smith Street, #02-126 Chinatown Complex Market & Food Centre, Singapore 050335.
The official page separately lists the nearby 78 Smith Street branch, showing the two Hawker Chan locations are distinct.
Official page lists the #02-126 stall hours as 10:30am–3:30pm and closed every Sunday (observed only as a current listing fact; not an image claim).
official_location_crosscheck.workbook_match: Official listing address and unit exactly match directory SFA record SM102126004. The other nearby 78 Smith Street location is not matched to this SFA record.

assessment.candidate_row_recommendation: Eligible to add as a dated Commons dish/brand-context image candidate for SM102126004, status review-only, retaining full Rainer Halama attribution, CC BY-SA 4.0 license/link, and share-alike obligations. Do not label it as a stall-front image or place it in Approved Image URL.
assessment.freshness_caveat: Captured 2023-08-24. Official listing confirms current outlet identity/location as of retrieval date but does not establish that the photographed sign, interior, food presentation, or operation remains current.
assessment.creator_request: Commons page requests that the creator be sent a specimen copy or URL where the image is used. If catalogue display proceeds, include this notice/attribution step in downstream use tracking.
